```{r helpers}
assert_file <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing required file: ", path)
  invisible(path)
}

read_required <- function(path, ...) {
  assert_file(path)
  fread(path, ...)
}

set_context_order <- function(dt, extra_order = character()) {
  rank_cols <- character()
  if ("context" %in% names(dt)) {
    dt[, context_rank_tmp := match(context, context_order)]
    rank_cols <- c(rank_cols, "context_rank_tmp")
  }
  if ("dataset_id" %in% names(dt)) {
    dt[, dataset_rank_tmp := match(dataset_id, dataset_order)]
    rank_cols <- c(rank_cols, "dataset_rank_tmp")
  }
  if ("split" %in% names(dt)) {
    dt[, split_rank_tmp := match(split, split_order)]
    rank_cols <- c(rank_cols, "split_rank_tmp")
  }
  ord <- intersect(c(extra_order, rank_cols, "gene_name", "gene_id", "variant_id", "lead_snp"), names(dt))
  if (length(ord) > 0) setorderv(dt, ord)
  dt[, (rank_cols) := NULL]
  invisible(dt)
}

front_order <- function(dt, front_cols) {
  setcolorder(dt, c(intersect(front_cols, names(dt)), setdiff(names(dt), front_cols)))
  invisible(dt)
}

add_dataset_id_to_summary <- function(dt) {
  out <- copy(dt)
  out[, dataset_id := unname(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID[context])]
  out
}

as_flag <- function(x) {
  as.integer(!is.na(x) & x == 1)
}

max_flag <- function(x) {
  x <- as.integer(x)
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_integer_)
  as.integer(max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

collapse_gene_list_limited <- function(x, max_chars = 30000L) {
  vals <- sort(unique(as.character(x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(as.character(x))])))
  if (length(vals) == 0L) {
    return(list(text = "", n_total = 0L, n_listed = 0L, truncated = FALSE))
  }

  text <- ""
  n_listed <- 0L
  for (val in vals) {
    candidate <- if (nzchar(text)) paste(text, val, sep = ", ") else val
    if (nchar(candidate, type = "chars", allowNA = FALSE) > max_chars) break
    text <- candidate
    n_listed <- n_listed + 1L
  }

  truncated <- n_listed < length(vals)
  if (isTRUE(truncated)) {
    suffix <- sprintf(" ... [truncated; %d of %d listed]", n_listed, length(vals))
    available <- max_chars - nchar(suffix, type = "chars", allowNA = FALSE)
    if (available > 0L) {
      text <- substr(text, 1L, available)
      text <- paste0(text, suffix)
    } else {
      text <- substr(text, 1L, max_chars)
    }
  }

  list(text = text, n_total = length(vals), n_listed = n_listed, truncated = truncated)
}

excel_widths <- function(dt, max_rows = 200L) {
  sample_n <- min(nrow(dt), max_rows)
  sample_dt <- if (sample_n > 0L) dt[seq_len(sample_n)] else dt
  widths <- vapply(names(dt), function(col) {
    vals <- as.character(sample_dt[[col]])
    max(c(nchar(col), nchar(vals)), na.rm = TRUE) + 2L
  }, numeric(1))
  widths <- pmin(pmax(widths, 8), 42)
  wide_cols <- grepl("genes$|gene_ids$|path|cache|thread_env|rule", names(dt), ignore.case = TRUE)
  widths[wide_cols] <- pmin(pmax(widths[wide_cols], 24), 80)
  widths
}

excel_number_formats <- function(dt) {
  nms <- names(dt)
  formats <- stats::setNames(rep(NA_character_, length(nms)), nms)
  lower <- tolower(nms)

  integer_cols <- grepl(
    paste(c(
      "^n_", "_n_", "^num_", "_count$", "count$", "rank$", "distance$",
      "samples$", "^nsnps$", "^cs95_n_snp$", "listed$", "rows$",
      "genes$", "variants$", "loci$", "tested$", "saved$", "input$",
      "error$", "null$", "workers$", "threads$", "pcs$", "members$"
    ), collapse = "|"),
    lower
  )
  flag_cols <- grepl(
    paste(c(
      "^deg$", "_deg$", "_eqtl$", "^lead_variant_in_", "^lead_variant_gwas_",
      "^gene_gwas_list$", "^gwas_support_"
    ), collapse = "|"),
    lower
  )
  sci_cols <- lower %in% c("pp0", "pp1", "pp2") |
    grepl("pval|qval|fdr|gwasp$", lower)
  probability_cols <- lower %in% c(
    "pp3", "pp4", "pp34", "pp4_over_pp34", "lead_snp_pph4",
    "lead_snp_ppsho", "af", "case_fraction_s"
  ) | grepl("frac|fraction|si_min|impinfo", lower)
  decimal_cols <- grepl("slope|beta|shape|df$|se$|elapsed_sec|min_abs|dosage_r", lower)

  formats[integer_cols] <- "#,##0"
  formats[flag_cols] <- "0"
  formats[decimal_cols] <- "0.000"
  formats[probability_cols] <- "0.0000"
  formats[sci_cols] <- "0.00E+00"
  formats[!vapply(dt, is.numeric, logical(1))] <- NA_character_
  formats
}

apply_excel_number_formats <- function(wb, sheet, dt) {
  if (nrow(dt) == 0L || ncol(dt) == 0L) return(invisible(FALSE))
  formats <- excel_number_formats(dt)
  formats <- formats[!is.na(formats)]
  if (length(formats) == 0L) return(invisible(FALSE))

  for (fmt in unique(unname(formats))) {
    cols <- match(names(formats)[formats == fmt], names(dt))
    style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = fmt)
    openxlsx::addStyle(
      wb,
      sheet = sheet,
      style = style,
      rows = seq.int(2L, nrow(dt) + 1L),
      cols = cols,
      gridExpand = TRUE,
      stack = TRUE
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

remove_dangling_openxlsx_relationships <- function(out_file) {
  unpack_dir <- tempfile("xlsx-unpack-")
  repaired_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
  dir.create(unpack_dir)
  on.exit(unlink(c(unpack_dir, repaired_file), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  unzip(out_file, exdir = unpack_dir)

  rel_files <- list.files(
    file.path(unpack_dir, "xl", "worksheets", "_rels"),
    pattern = "[.]rels$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  for (rel_file in rel_files) {
    doc <- xml2::read_xml(rel_file)
    rel_nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(doc, ".//*[local-name()='Relationship']")
    source_dir <- dirname(dirname(rel_file))
    for (node in rel_nodes) {
      target <- xml2::xml_attr(node, "Target")
      rel_type <- xml2::xml_attr(node, "Type")
      target_path <- normalizePath(file.path(source_dir, target), mustWork = FALSE)
      is_drawing <- grepl("/(drawing|vmlDrawing)$", rel_type)
      if (is_drawing && !file.exists(target_path)) xml2::xml_remove(node)
    }
    xml2::write_xml(doc, rel_file, options = "format")
  }

  zip::zip(
    repaired_file,
    files = list.files(unpack_dir, recursive = TRUE, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE),
    root = unpack_dir,
    include_directories = FALSE
  )
  if (!file.copy(repaired_file, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)) {
    stop("Failed to replace workbook after repairing dangling relationships: ", out_file)
  }
  invisible(out_file)
}

write_final_workbook <- function(sheets, out_file, apply_number_formats = FALSE) {
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    textDecoration = "bold",
    fgFill = "#D9EAF7",
    border = "Bottom",
    borderStyle = "thin"
  )

  for (sheet in names(sheets)) {
    if (nchar(sheet) > 31L) stop("Excel sheet name is too long: ", sheet)
    dt <- as.data.table(sheets[[sheet]])
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet, gridLines = TRUE)
    openxlsx::writeDataTable(
      wb,
      sheet = sheet,
      x = dt,
      tableStyle = "TableStyleLight9",
      headerStyle = header_style,
      withFilter = TRUE
    )
    openxlsx::freezePane(wb, sheet, firstRow = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = seq_along(dt), widths = excel_widths(dt))
    if (isTRUE(apply_number_formats)) {
      apply_excel_number_formats(wb, sheet = sheet, dt = dt)
    }
  }

  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  remove_dangling_openxlsx_relationships(out_file)
  invisible(out_file)
}

verify_xlsx <- function(out_file, expected_sheets, expected_nrows, expected_columns) {
  actual_sheets <- openxlsx::getSheetNames(out_file)
  if (!identical(actual_sheets, expected_sheets)) {
    stop(
      "Unexpected sheets in ", out_file, ". Expected: ",
      paste(expected_sheets, collapse = ", "), "; observed: ",
      paste(actual_sheets, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  observed <- lapply(expected_sheets, function(sheet) {
    dt <- as.data.table(openxlsx::read.xlsx(out_file, sheet = sheet))
    if (ncol(dt) == 0L) stop("Sheet has no headers: ", sheet, " in ", out_file)
    if (!identical(names(dt), expected_columns[[sheet]])) {
      stop(
        "Unexpected columns in ", sheet, " in ", out_file,
        ". Expected: ", paste(expected_columns[[sheet]], collapse = ", "),
        "; observed: ", paste(names(dt), collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
    if (nrow(dt) != expected_nrows[[sheet]]) {
      stop(
        "Unexpected row count for ", sheet, " in ", out_file,
        ": expected ", expected_nrows[[sheet]], ", observed ", nrow(dt)
      )
    }
    data.table(sheet = sheet, n_rows = nrow(dt), n_cols = ncol(dt))
  })
  rbindlist(observed)
}
```

```{r load-inputs}
  manifest_qc = file.path(tables_dir, "manifest_qc.csv"),
  coloc_gated = file.path(coloc_tables_dir, "coloc_abf_results_gated.tsv.gz"),
  coloc_summary = file.path(coloc_tables_dir, "coloc_abf_summary_by_domainCT.csv"),
  category_summary = file.path(coloc_tables_dir, "coloc_abf_category_summary.csv"),

)

cis_independent <- read_required(paths$cis_independent)
nominal_BH05 <- read_required(paths$nominal_BH05)

export_variant_ids <- unique(c(cis_independent$variant_id, nominal_BH05$variant_id))
variant_info <- load_genotype_variant_info(
  plink2_prefix = plink2_prefix,
  use_cache = TRUE,
  build_if_missing = FALSE
)
rsid_lut <- variant_info[
  data.table(variant_id = export_variant_ids),
  on = "variant_id",
  nomatch = 0L,
  .(variant_id, rsid, rsid_source)
]
if (uniqueN(rsid_lut$variant_id) != length(export_variant_ids)) {
  missing_variant_ids <- setdiff(export_variant_ids, rsid_lut$variant_id)
  stop(
    "Genotype variant cache is missing exported eQTL variants: ",
    paste(head(missing_variant_ids, 20L), collapse = ", "),
    if (length(missing_variant_ids) > 20L) " ..." else ""
  )
}
setkey(rsid_lut, variant_id)

add_genotype_rsids <- function(dt, label) {
  out <- copy(dt)
  out[rsid_lut, on = "variant_id", `:=`(
    rsid = i.rsid,
    rsid_source = i.rsid_source
  )]
  if (anyNA(out$rsid) || anyNA(out$rsid_source)) {
    stop(label, " has missing rsID annotations after joining the genotype variant cache")
  }
  bad_rsids <- unique(out[nzchar(rsid) & !grepl("^rs[0-9]+$", rsid), rsid])
  if (length(bad_rsids) > 0L) {
    stop(label, " has malformed rsIDs: ", paste(head(bad_rsids, 20L), collapse = ", "))
  }
  out
}

add_legacy_overlap_aliases <- function(dt) {
  out <- copy(dt)
  for (dis in disorders) {
    out[, (paste0(dis, "_GWAS")) := get(paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_strict"))]
    out[, (paste0(dis, "_GWASg")) := get(paste0(dis, "_gwas_strict"))]
    out[, (paste0(dis, "_GWASg_variant")) := get(paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_strict"))]
    out[, (paste0(dis, "_GWASg_gene")) := get(paste0(dis, "_gwasGene"))]
  }
  for (dis in c("MDD", "BD")) {
    out[, (paste0(dis, "_GWASx")) := get(paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_exp"))]
    out[, (paste0(dis, "_GWASxg")) := get(paste0(dis, "_gwas_exp"))]
    out[, (paste0(dis, "_GWASxg_variant")) := get(paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_exp"))]
    out[, (paste0(dis, "_GWASxg_gene")) := get(paste0(dis, "_gwasGene"))]
  }
  out
}

summarize_exact_variant_overlaps <- function(dt) {
  out <- unique(dt[, .(split, context)])
  specs <- list(
    MDD_strict = c("MDD", "strict", "MDD_gwasVar_strict"),
    MDD_exp = c("MDD", "exp", "MDD_gwasVar_exp"),
    BD_strict = c("BD", "strict", "BD_gwasVar_strict"),
    BD_exp = c("BD", "exp", "BD_gwasVar_exp"),
    SCZD_strict = c("SCZD", "strict", "SCZD_gwasVar_strict")
  )
  for (spec in specs) {
    dis <- spec[[1]]
    level <- spec[[2]]
    flag_col <- spec[[3]]
    count_col <- paste0("n_", dis, "_gwasVar_", level)
    genes_col <- paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_", level, "_genes")
    observed <- dt[get(flag_col) == 1L, .(
      exact_count = uniqueN(gene_id),
      exact_genes = collapse_gene_list(gene_name)
    ), by = .(split, context)]
    setnames(observed, c("exact_count", "exact_genes"), c(count_col, genes_col))
    out <- merge(out, observed, by = c("split", "context"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
    out[is.na(get(count_col)), (count_col) := 0L]
    out[is.na(get(genes_col)), (genes_col) := ""]
  }
  out
}

summarize_recovered_pairs <- function(dt) {
  observed_splits <- intersect(split_order, unique(dt$split))
  legacy <- add_legacy_overlap_aliases(dt)
  strict <- summarize_significant_pairs(
    legacy,
    context_order = context_order,
    split_order = observed_splits,
    disorder_related = degs$disorder_related,
    gwas_disorders = disorders
  )
  exploratory <- summarize_gwasx_significant_pairs(
    legacy,
    context_order = context_order,
    split_order = observed_splits,
    disorder_related = degs$disorder_related,
    gwasx_disorders = c("MDD", "BD")
  )
  out <- build_merged_significant_summary(strict, exploratory)

  signal_audit <- dt[, .(
    n_eQTL_signals = uniqueN(signal_id),
    n_signal_member_pairs = .N
  ), by = .(split, context)]
  out <- merge(out, signal_audit, by = c("split", "context"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  out <- merge(out, summarize_exact_variant_overlaps(dt), by = c("split", "context"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  front_order(
    out,
    c(
      "split", "context", "n_eQTL_signals", "n_signal_member_pairs",
      "n_significant_pairs", "n_cis_supported_pairs", "n_indep_supported_pairs",
      "n_shared_pairs", "n_cis_only_pairs", "n_indep_only_pairs", "n_eGenes"
    )
  )
  set_context_order(out)
  out
}

map_cis_summary <- summarize_recovered_pairs(cis_independent[cis_supported == TRUE])
map_independent_summary <- summarize_recovered_pairs(cis_independent[indep_supported == TRUE])

    "n_signal_member_pairs"
  )
)
map_significant_summary <- summarize_recovered_pairs(cis_independent)
```

```{r gene-intersections}
make_gene_level <- function(dt) {
  flag_cols <- grep("_(DEG|gwasVar_strict|gwasVar_exp|gwasGene|gwas_strict|gwas_exp)$|^DEG$", names(dt), value = TRUE)
  out <- unique(dt[, c("dataset_id", "context", "split", "gene_id", "gene_name", flag_cols), with = FALSE])
  out <- out[, lapply(.SD, max_flag),
    by = .(dataset_id, context, split, gene_id, gene_name),
    .SDcols = flag_cols
  ]
  if (!"DEG" %in% names(out)) out[, DEG := as.integer(gene_id %in% broad_deg_ids)]
  out[, DEG := as_flag(DEG)]

  for (dis in c("MDD", "BD")) {
    col <- paste0(dis, "_DEG")
    ids <- disorder_deg_ids[[dis]]
    if (!is.null(ids)) out[, (col) := as.integer(gene_id %in% ids)]
  }
  out
}

append_gene_row <- function(rows, eQTL_type, sub, disorder, annotation_set, selected) {
  gene_ids <- collapse_gene_list_limited(selected$gene_id)
  gene_names <- collapse_gene_list_limited(selected$gene_name)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.table(
    eQTL_type = eQTL_type,
    dataset_id = sub$dataset_id[[1]],
    context = sub$context[[1]],
    split = sub$split[[1]],
    disorder = disorder,
    annotation_set = annotation_set,
    n_genes = gene_ids$n_total,
    gene_ids = gene_ids$text,
    gene_ids_listed = gene_ids$n_listed,
    gene_ids_truncated = gene_ids$truncated,
    gene_names = gene_names$text,
    gene_names_listed = gene_names$n_listed,
    gene_names_truncated = gene_names$truncated
  )
  rows
}

flag_subset <- function(sub, col) {
  if (!col %in% names(sub)) return(NULL)
  sub[get(col) == 1]
}

build_intersections <- function(dt, eQTL_type) {
  gene_dt <- make_gene_level(dt)
  groups <- unique(gene_dt[, .(dataset_id, context, split)])
  set_context_order(groups)

  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
    key <- groups[i]
    sub <- gene_dt[key, on = .(dataset_id, context, split)]
    rows <- append_gene_row(rows, eQTL_type, sub, "all", "all_eGenes", sub)
    rows <- append_gene_row(rows, eQTL_type, sub, "all", "broad_DEG_eGenes", sub[DEG == 1])

    for (dis in c("MDD", "BD")) {
      deg_col <- paste0(dis, "_DEG")
      if (deg_col %in% names(sub)) {
        rows <- append_gene_row(rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0(dis, "_DEG_eGenes"), sub[get(deg_col) == 1])
      }
    }

    for (dis in disorders) {
      strict_var <- flag_subset(sub, paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_strict"))
      strict_gene <- flag_subset(sub, paste0(dis, "_gwasGene"))
      strict_any <- flag_subset(sub, paste0(dis, "_gwas_strict"))
      exp_var <- flag_subset(sub, paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_exp"))
      exp_any <- flag_subset(sub, paste0(dis, "_gwas_exp"))
      deg_col <- paste0(dis, "_DEG")

      if (!is.null(strict_var)) rows <- append_gene_row(rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_strict_eGenes"), strict_var)
      if (!is.null(strict_gene)) rows <- append_gene_row(rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0(dis, "_gwasGene_eGenes"), strict_gene)
      if (!is.null(strict_any)) {
        rows <- append_gene_row(rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0(dis, "_gwas_strict_eGenes"), strict_any)
        rows <- append_gene_row(
          rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0("broad_DEG_x_", dis, "_gwas_strict"),
          sub[DEG == 1 & get(paste0(dis, "_gwas_strict")) == 1]
        )
        if (deg_col %in% names(sub)) {
          rows <- append_gene_row(
            rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0(dis, "_DEG_x_", dis, "_gwas_strict"),
            sub[get(deg_col) == 1 & get(paste0(dis, "_gwas_strict")) == 1]
          )
        }
      }
      if (!is.null(exp_var)) rows <- append_gene_row(rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0(dis, "_gwasVar_exp_eGenes"), exp_var)
      if (!is.null(exp_any)) {
        rows <- append_gene_row(rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0(dis, "_gwas_exp_eGenes"), exp_any)
        rows <- append_gene_row(
          rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0("broad_DEG_x_", dis, "_gwas_exp"),
          sub[DEG == 1 & get(paste0(dis, "_gwas_exp")) == 1]
        )
        if (deg_col %in% names(sub)) {
          rows <- append_gene_row(
            rows, eQTL_type, sub, dis, paste0(dis, "_DEG_x_", dis, "_gwas_exp"),
            sub[get(deg_col) == 1 & get(paste0(dis, "_gwas_exp")) == 1]
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }

  out <- rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  set_context_order(out, extra_order = c("eQTL_type", "disorder", "annotation_set"))
  out
}

intersecting_genes <- rbindlist(
  list(
    build_intersections(cis_independent, "cis_independent"),
    build_intersections(nominal_BH05, "nominal_BH05")
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)
```

```{r validation}
compare_summary_count <- function(source_summary, final_summary, eqtl_type_value, count_col) {
  expected <- add_dataset_id_to_summary(source_summary)[, .(
    dataset_id, context, split, expected = get(count_col)
  )]
  actual <- final_summary[get("eQTL_type") == eqtl_type_value, .(
    dataset_id, context, split, actual = get(count_col)
  )]
  check <- merge(expected, actual, by = c("dataset_id", "context", "split"), all = TRUE)
  if (check[is.na(expected) | is.na(actual) | expected != actual, .N] > 0L) {
    print(check[is.na(expected) | is.na(actual) | expected != actual])
    stop("Summary count mismatch for ", eqtl_type_value, " / ", count_col)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

compare_unchanged_summary_count <- function(before, after, count_col, label) {

    before[, .(split, context, before = get(count_col))],
    after[, .(split, context, after = get(count_col))],
    by = c("split", "context"),
    all = TRUE
  )
  if (check[is.na(before) | is.na(after) | before != after, .N] > 0L) {
    print(check[is.na(before) | is.na(after) | before != after])
    stop("Exact-tie recovery unexpectedly changed ", label, " / ", count_col)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r public-eqtl-sheets}
make_cis_independent_public <- function(dt) {
  out <- data.table::copy(dt)
  out[, eQTL_signal_class := fcase(
    pair_provenance == "cis_and_independent", "lead_cis_and_independent",
    pair_provenance == "cis_only", "lead_cis_only",
    pair_provenance == "independent_only", "independent_signal",
    default = pair_provenance
  )]
  out[, lead_cis_qval := fifelse(!is.na(qval), qval, qval_parent)]
  out[, independent_signal_rank := fifelse(
    signal_kind == "conditionally_independent",
    as.integer(signal_rank),
    NA_integer_
  )]
  out[, eQTL_signal_id := signal_id]
  out[!nzchar(rsid), rsid := NA_character_]

  cols <- c(
    "context", "gene_id", "gene_name", "eQTL_signal_id", "eQTL_signal_class",
    "independent_signal_rank", "variant_id", "rsid",
    "DEG", "MDD_DEG", "BD_DEG",
    "MDD_gwasVar_strict", "MDD_gwasVar_exp", "MDD_gwasGene", "MDD_gwas_strict", "MDD_gwas_exp",
    "BD_gwasVar_strict", "BD_gwasVar_exp", "BD_gwasGene", "BD_gwas_strict", "BD_gwas_exp",
    "SCZD_gwasVar_strict", "SCZD_gwasGene", "SCZD_gwas_strict",
    "start_distance", "end_distance", "af",
    "pval_nominal", "slope", "slope_se", "pval_perm", "lead_cis_qval"
  )
  assert_cols(out, cols, "public cis_independent")
  out[, ..cols]
}

make_nominal_public <- function(dt) {
  out <- data.table::copy(dt)
  out[!nzchar(rsid), rsid := NA_character_]
  cols <- c(
    "context", "gene_id", "gene_name", "variant_id", "rsid", "DEG",
    "MDD_gwasVar_strict", "MDD_gwasGene", "MDD_gwas_strict",
    "BD_gwasVar_strict", "BD_gwasGene", "BD_gwas_strict",
    "SCZD_gwasVar_strict", "SCZD_gwasGene", "SCZD_gwas_strict",
    "start_distance", "af", "pval_nominal", "fdr", "slope", "slope_se"
  )
  assert_cols(out, cols, "public nominal_BH05")
  out[, ..cols]
}

make_eqtl_summary_public <- function(dt) {
  out <- data.table::copy(dt)
  if ("n_genes_bed" %in% names(out)) {
    data.table::setnames(out, "n_genes_bed", "n_genes_tested")
  }
  count_cols <- grep("^n_", names(out), value = TRUE)
  drop_counts <- c("n_genes_pca", "n_expr_pcs")
  cols <- c(
    "eQTL_type", "context", "n_samples", "n_genes_tested",
    setdiff(count_cols, c("n_samples", "n_genes_tested", drop_counts))
  )
  cols <- intersect(cols, names(out))
  out[, ..cols]
}

make_intersecting_genes_public <- function(dt) {
  out <- data.table::copy(dt[n_genes > 0L])
  cols <- c(
    "eQTL_type", "context", "disorder", "annotation_set", "n_genes",
    "gene_ids", "gene_ids_listed", "gene_ids_truncated", "gene_names"
  )
  assert_cols(out, cols, "public intersecting_genes")
  out[, ..cols]
}

cis_independent_public <- make_cis_independent_public(cis_independent)
nominal_BH05_public <- make_nominal_public(nominal_BH05)
eQTL_summary_public <- make_eqtl_summary_public(eQTL_summary)
intersecting_genes_public <- make_intersecting_genes_public(intersecting_genes)
```

```{r write-final-workbooks}
  expected_nrows = lapply(coloc_sheets, nrow),

)

list(
  eqtl_results = eqtl_xlsx,
  coloc_results = coloc_xlsx,
  rsid_qc = data.table(
    n_unique_variants = nrow(rsid_qc),
    n_variants_with_rsid = rsid_qc[nzchar(rsid), .N],
    n_variants_without_rsid = rsid_qc[!nzchar(rsid), .N]
  ),
  eqtl_verify = eqtl_verify,
  coloc_verify = coloc_verify
)
```
